summary: Iteration 163: Comprehensive quality overhaul testing of naukri_regex_parser.py. All 45 new tests passed (100%). Verified: Address line filtering (_is_address_line), skills garbage filtering (_clean_skill), notice period patterns (days/weeks/available-to-join/buyout), expected CTC patterns, education improvements (ITI/Graduation/Doctorate), work experience boundaries (Project Manager fix), employer/designation backfill from work experience, summary extraction with Resume Headline fallback. All 105 previous tests (iterations 158-162) also pass.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ Address lines ('Residence Add.', 'C/o', 'H.No', 'Flat No', 'Colony') NEVER appear in employer, designation, or work experience - _is_address_line() helper works correctly
✅ Skills extraction filters garbage (addresses, nav text, numbers) - _clean_skill() helper works correctly
✅ Notice Period handles: X Months, X Days, X Weeks, Available to join, Can join, Immediate, Serving Notice, Buyout, standalone months
✅ Expected CTC handles: expects ₹ X Lacs, Expected CTC: X LPA, Exp CTC: X, Looking for X, Desired CTC: X
✅ Education handles: labeled sections (Education:, Qualification:), ITI/Graduation/Doctorate patterns
✅ Summary handles: Profile Summary, Career Objective, Resume Headline fallback, synthesized fallback with skills
✅ Work experience section boundaries don't stop at 'Project Manager' or 'Project Lead' (designation names containing 'Project')
✅ Employer extracted from work experience backfill when header/labeled patterns fail
✅ Designation extracted from work experience backfill when header/labeled patterns fail
✅ Naukri concatenated header: CTC, Expected CTC, Notice Period, Experience Years correctly extracted
✅ Full profile extraction with all fields populated correctly for clean Naukri format
✅ Full profile extraction for address-heavy profile (address NOT in employer/work exp)
✅ Format A (pipe 'Title | Company') regression - still works
✅ Format B ('Title at Company') regression - still works
✅ Admin routes to regex parser, recruiter routes to Claude

success_rate.backend: 100% (45/45 tests in iteration 163, 105/105 in previous iterations 158-162)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Naukri Regex Parser (naukri_regex_parser.py) comprehensive quality overhaul fully tested. All 150 tests across iterations 158-163 pass.
